hypothesis: A new policy learned from training-only prefix trajectory and future-task correctness can identify when further recurrent computation has insufficient expected benefit, saving at least 15% steps at >=95% novel-grammar question accuracy and outperforming a train-selected simple confidence threshold.

training.freeze_existing: F10 22-parameter frozen core+16 role weights; no scientific F3 touch
training.train_stop_targets: training-only hindsight safe-stop if current prediction matches final truth and all future prefix predictions; never given to candidate inference
training.policy: 7 prefix-only features, 7->8 tanh->1 logistic controller (73 params), 160 Adam lr .035, train-only BCE
training.candidate_input_only: current prefix probability, delta, active max/mean/std, normalized step and remaining budget; no oracle/future hidden state/labels or graph family
controls: grid threshold selected by train utility only (values frozen before heldout)
hindsight oracle upper using future ground truth only after original predictions

evaluation.three_conditions: valid ordered typed path, one edge-role mutation, invalid same-bag order
